description: Collect wood in a beginner-friendly forest with fewer, weaker monsters.
label: d052_d052_r0_0000
short_reason: Initial easy task focusing on wood collection for a new student.

description: Craft a wooden pickaxe to start mining stone.
label: d052_d052_r0_0001
short_reason: Default multipliers for a new student with no prior skills; task focuses on basic tool crafting.

description: Defeat a zombie. Zombies are tougher with 1.5x health and damage. Passive animal spawns reduced to 0.5x to minimize distractions.
label: d052_d052_r0_0002
short_reason: Baseline combat task for round 0 with no student history; moderate zombie challenge.

description: Navigate through a cave system, exploring various underground biomes and finding the exit or valuable resources while avoiding mobs.
label: d052_d052_r0_0003
short_reason: Reduced mob presence to ease cave exploration and navigation.

description: Place a crafting table in a mostly peaceful environment with very weak hostile mobs, suited for a build task focusing on the place_table skill.
label: d052_d052_r0_0004
short_reason: Budgeted Soft Copeland selected easy settings for empty snapshot and build/place_table theme, minimizing combat threats.

description: Focus on managing your hunger by gathering and cooking food. Passive animals are more abundant, and hostile creatures are weaker, allowing you to concentrate on survival needs.
label: d052_d052_r0_0005
short_reason: Reduced hostile mob threat and increased passive spawns to isolate hunger management.

description: Channel your inner magic and learn to enchant a weapon. Weakened foes will allow you to focus on gathering the necessary runes and essence.
label: d052_d052_r0_0006
short_reason: Initial introduction to enchanting with reduced threat for learning.

description: Collect wood by punching trees. Learn the basics of resource gathering.
label: d052_d052_r0_0007
short_reason: Easy wood collection task for resource theme.

description: Craft a wooden pickaxe and mine a stone block.
label: d052_d052_r0_0008
short_reason: Easy task for a new agent to learn crafting a pickaxe with minimal mob threats.

description: Defeat zombies using your combat abilities.
label: d052_d052_r0_0009
short_reason: Baseline task with standard multipliers for initial assessment.

description: Navigate the cave system: find the entrance and descend to depth y=20. Mobs are weaker and spawn less frequently.
label: d052_d052_r0_0010
short_reason: Empty student snapshot; easy cave exploration with reduced threats.

description: Collect wood, craft a crafting table, and place it.
label: d052_d052_r0_0011
short_reason: Initial build task to teach placing a crafting table with easy mobs.

description: Survive the wilderness by keeping your hunger bar full. Hunt passive animals for food while avoiding starvation. Difficulty is set low to focus on learning hunger management.
label: d052_d052_r0_0012
short_reason: Round 0 baseline for manage_hunger skill with abundant passive mobs and weakened hostile mobs to minimize distraction.

description: Embark on your magical journey by learning to enchant a weapon. Locate an enchanting table or gather arcane materials to infuse a basic weapon with a simple spell. Then use your enchanted blade to vanquish a weakened forest creature.
label: d052_d052_r0_0013
short_reason: First exposure to enchant_weapon; drastically reduced enemy spawn rate, health, and damage to ensure a safe learning environment.

description: Collect wood to craft essential tools. The environment is calm, with few hostile creatures and reduced threat.
label: d052_d052_r0_0014
short_reason: Student has no prior skills; an easy wood-gathering task with minimal danger allows practice of collect_wood.

description: Craft a wooden pickaxe using a crafting table.
label: d052_d052_r0_0015
short_reason: Empty student snapshot: first task teaches basic tool crafting.

description: Practice combat by defeating a weakened zombie.
label: d052_d052_r0_0016
short_reason: Easy starter task: zombie health and damage halved for safe combat practice.

description: Explore the depths of the cave system, carefully navigating the dark passages and uncovering hidden chambers.
label: d052_d052_r0_0017
short_reason: Empty snapshot with explore theme and navigate_cave skill; easy initial task to practice cave navigation with reduced threats.

description: Place a crafting table.
label: d052_d052_r0_0018
short_reason: Basic building task: place a table.

description: Survive for 3 days while keeping your hunger bar above 50%. Collect food from passive animals and avoid hostile mobs.
label: d052_d052_r0_0019
short_reason: Increased passive spawns provide abundant food, and reduced mob threat minimizes combat distraction, allowing the student to focus entirely on hunger management.

description: Learn to enchant a weapon in a magical world. Gather resources, craft a wooden sword, and enchant it.
label: d052_d052_r0_0020
short_reason: Initial magic-themed task for enchant_weapon skill; round 0 easy setup.

description: Gather wood by chopping trees. This is an introductory resource collection task.
label: d052_d052_r0_0021
short_reason: Empty snapshot, round 0: start with easy wood collection, reduced mob threats.

description: Craft a wooden pickaxe using gathered wood.
label: d052_d052_r0_0022
short_reason: Safe environment with minimal hostiles to practice pickaxe crafting.

description: Defeat a zombie. Zombies spawn more frequently but have reduced health and damage.
label: d052_d052_r0_0023
short_reason: Abundant weak zombies for initial combat training.

description: Explore the cave to find iron ore. Mobs in the cave have reduced health and damage, making navigation safer.
label: d052_d052_r0_0024
short_reason: Easier cave exploration with halved mob health and damage.

description: Craft a table and place it in the world.
label: d052_d052_r0_0025
short_reason: Empty student snapshot; assign an easy building task to introduce table placement.

description: Survive in the standard Craftax environment. Focus on keeping your hunger in check by gathering food and hunting passive creatures while avoiding dangerous mobs.
label: d052_d052_r0_0026
short_reason: Original game balance; introduces hunger management in the standard survival setting.

description: Use magic to enchant your weapon.
label: d052_d052_r0_0027
short_reason: Easy enchant weapon task with low mob threats.

description: Collect wood to reach the easy and medium milestones. First, gather 10 wood logs. Then, gather 50 wood logs.
label: d052_d052_r0_0028
short_reason: Very low enemy presence and strength make wood collection trivial.

description: Craft a stone pickaxe using collected wood and stone.
label: d052_d052_r0_0029
short_reason: Initial easy task to craft a basic stone pickaxe with reduced enemy threats.

description: Defeat a zombie in combat.
label: d052_d052_r0_0030
short_reason: Default medium difficulty combat task for zombie.

description: Navigate through the cave system, exploring its depths and discovering hidden passages.
label: d052_d052_r0_0031
short_reason: Low threat environment for cave navigation practice.
